record.one_liner: Smartsheet is a cloud work-management platform built around spreadsheet-style sheets, reports, dashboards and automation for teams to plan and track work.
record.auth_notes: Personal API access token sent as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow for third-party apps: register an app in Developer Tools to get a client ID and secret, authorize at app.smartsheet.com/b/authorize with scopes, POST /token. Access tokens last about 7 days and are refreshable.
record.access_notes: The OpenAPI reference says the API is limited to Business and Enterprise plans. OAuth app registration needs Developer Tools registration, which requires accepting the Developer Agreement and can be denied by Smartsheet. The OAuth guide advises a separate service account. I did not verify a free sandbox or free developer account: the register page exists, but the fetched docs don't state its cost or whether it is free. Only a user forum post says a paid license is needed for tokens. I found no documented app-review step before production use.
record.blocker: The API needs a paid Business or Enterprise plan, and no free tier or free sandbox is documented. OAuth app registration under Developer Tools can be denied by Smartsheet. Some endpoints, such as Events, need add-ons.
